summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K carrying a routine Total Voting Rights announcement dated 2 November 2026, disclosing share capital as at 31 October 2026: 15,706,030,643 ordinary shares outstanding (par $0.25, one vote each) excluding 780,282,351 treasury shares, plus 12,706,252 preference shares carrying two votes per five in nominal capital, giving 15,711,113,143 total voting rights. The notice is made under the UK FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules 5.6 so holders can assess notification thresholds—the US equivalent of a periodic share-count/threshold disclosure. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, or regulatory clock is involved; no risk-arb angle exists beyond routine capital-structure monitoring.
